title: Conventional Versus Robot Assisted Laparoscopic Inguinal Hernia Repair
brief_summary: Evaluate the early postoperative course of patients undergoing laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair with either a conventional or a robot assisted approach and with or without the injection of the trocar wounds with a local anesthetic.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult patients presenting with a bilateral inguinal hernia planned for a minimal invasive laparoscopic repair

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age below 18 years
* unilateral groin hernia repair
* incarcerated hernias
* open hernia repair
* no informed consent
* pregnant women
* ASA score 4 or more
* patient included in another study.
